summary: First session. Portfolio was 100% cash. Researched: price data show quotes lag (10-28 midday bars); MSFT and GOOGL reported after close Oct 28 (results NOT visible to me yet), AMZN and AAPL report after close Oct 29. Fed expected to hold (Chair Warsh). Chip rally on SK Hynix results, Broadcom $63B AI financing, Anthropic IPO filing; Meta raised capex Oct 21 and sold off; MSFT/META punished for AI spending. Decision: bought chip suppliers NVDA 12%, AVGO 10%, AMD 6% (28% invested, 72% cash), deliberately avoiding names with binary earnings (GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN, AAPL) until reactions are known. Next session: check the MSFT/GOOGL post-earnings reaction and AMZN/AAPL results, decide whether to add hyperscalers; check AMD earnings date (early Nov) and PLTR earnings; note that cash is a drag versus the equal-weight benchmark, so consider raising exposure if evidence supports it.
